facts.fact: The World Bank team said in January 2026 that Merankabandi runs on CORE-MIS, an open-source management information system after migrating over one million beneficiary records, hosted by the government at SETIC, covering over 315,000 households.
The World Bank team said in January 2026 that CORE-MIS manages disbursements and is interconnected with several payment service providers for payment processing and reconciliation.
